data.name: You are a torpedo AI
data.detailed_description:
"You are a torpedo AI" is a game where, well, you are a torpedo AI.
You must guide the torpedo to its target, avoiding collisions with the obstacles on the way. The game is fast paced and has simple controls, but it is also really challenging and fun.

Features:

  • Over 90 levels
  • Several different obstacles
  • Speedrun mode
  • Cool music by Kevin Macleod
  • Psychedelic backgrounds
  • Turtles

reviews.review:
You are a torpedo AI is an arcade-style indie game developed and published by Leonardo Alexandrino that embraces a straightforward concept while delivering a surprisingly demanding challenge. Instead of placing players in the role of a pilot or military commander, the game casts them as the artificial intelligence controlling a torpedo on its mission toward a target. The premise is intentionally simple, allowing the gameplay to become the central attraction. Every stage is built around navigating dangerous obstacle-filled environments where precision, timing, and quick reactions are the only tools needed to survive. Its minimalist design reflects a classic arcade philosophy that focuses on improving player skill rather than relying on complex mechanics or narrative elements.

The core gameplay revolves around steering the torpedo through increasingly difficult courses packed with barriers and hazards. Although the controls are easy to understand from the beginning, mastering them requires patience and consistency as later stages introduce tighter spaces and more demanding layouts. With more than ninety handcrafted levels, the game steadily raises the difficulty while avoiding dramatic changes to its central formula. Each successful completion feels earned because progress depends entirely on the player's ability to react quickly and adapt to new obstacle patterns. The inclusion of a Speedrun mode also adds meaningful replay value, encouraging experienced players to optimize every movement and compete against their own best times.

Its visual presentation favors clarity over graphical complexity. Bright, colorful backgrounds give each stage a distinctive appearance without interfering with gameplay, ensuring that obstacles remain easy to identify during fast-paced moments. The minimalist style suits the game's design philosophy, eliminating unnecessary distractions and allowing players to concentrate entirely on the challenge ahead. While it lacks the visual sophistication of larger productions, the clean presentation effectively supports the gameplay and maintains a consistent aesthetic from beginning to end.

The audio complements the action with energetic music that keeps the pace lively throughout each level. Sound effects provide immediate feedback for movement, collisions, and successful navigation, helping reinforce the rhythm of play without becoming overwhelming. The soundtrack fits naturally with the arcade atmosphere, contributing to the overall sense of momentum as players repeatedly attempt to overcome difficult stages. Although the production values remain modest, the combination of music and sound design successfully enhances the gameplay experience without overshadowing it.

One of the game's strongest qualities is its commitment to a focused vision. It does not attempt to overwhelm players with elaborate progression systems, extensive customization, or unnecessary features. Instead, every aspect of the experience serves the central objective of mastering increasingly challenging obstacle courses. This streamlined approach gives the game a satisfying sense of purpose, especially for players who appreciate skill-based arcade experiences. On the other hand, those searching for a story-driven adventure, a wide variety of gameplay mechanics, or long-term progression may find the overall package somewhat limited. Its appeal is closely tied to enjoying repeated attempts, gradual improvement, and the satisfaction of overcoming difficult levels through practice alone.

Overall, You are a torpedo AI succeeds as a focused and entertaining arcade title that understands its strengths. Leonardo Alexandrino delivers a compact experience centered on responsive controls, steadily escalating challenges, and rewarding gameplay built around player mastery. The extensive collection of levels, accessible mechanics, vibrant minimalist visuals, and competitive Speedrun mode create an enjoyable package for fans of reflex-based games. While its limited scope means it will not appeal equally to every type of player, it accomplishes its design goals with confidence and offers a rewarding challenge for anyone seeking a pure arcade experience.

Rating: 6/10
